subject: Datadog contract: license scope & log-tiering negotiation
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@datadog.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Scope + pricing for logs archival add-on

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We ran the usage report and are seeing sustained spikes in high-cardinality logs from a handful of services (auth, payment, realtime ingestion) that push us over our current plan several times a month. Before we lock into a longer term I want to confirm a practical, cost-predictable approach for the next 12 months:

- Current ask: 90-day hot retention for production logs, 3-year cold archival (infrequent retrieval).
- Constraint: infra wants a clear per-month cap on monthly ingestion/egress overages to avoid surprise billing.
- Goal: reduce tokenized ingestion billing by ~30% while keeping quick access for on-call.

Can you send a revised proposal that:
1) separates ingestion vs storage (cold S3-compatible archival option)
2) includes a priced cap tier (monthly) for burst protection
3) a short SOW for any migration work and an estimate for rehydration egress fees

I attached our internal usage export (summary) to help price the tiers.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — trying to close procurement the week of Mar 15.

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Platform Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Emma Li <emma.li@datadog.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dan Sato <dan.sato@datadog.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scope + pricing for logs archival add-on

Hi Sofia —

Appreciate the detail and the export — that helps a lot. Attached is an initial proposal with three options:

A) Standard: Increase current ingestion tier by 25%, 90-day hot retention, native Datadog cold storage (30% cheaper than hot).
B) Hybrid (recommended): Keep ingestion at current level, route cold storage to S3 (we manage lifecycle), 3-year archival. Lower monthly storage cost but add egress on rehydration.
C) Committed: 12-month commit with 10% discount across ingestion/storage, includes a monthly overage cap option for an additional fixed fee.

Notes:
- Rehydration: billed per GB egress; we can offer a capped monthly bucket if you want predictable charges.
- Migration SOW: included as a draft (SOW-log-archival.xlsx).

I attached Datadog_Proposal_Q2-2027.pdf with line-item pricing and Dan will follow up on specific egress/cap numbers. Happy to hop on a 30-min call to walk through.

Best,
Emma Li
Enterprise Account Executive, Datadog
Attachment: Datadog_Proposal_Q2-2027.pdf (proposal)
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@datadog.com>, Dan Sato <dan.sato@datadog.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scope + pricing for logs archival add-on

Emma —

Thanks, the menu is helpful. A few follow-ups from infra and procurement:

- Hybrid is attractive but we need detail on egress caps. Can you provide an example monthly cap at the 95th percentile of our current retrievals and a priced cap option (USD/month)?
- For committed option, procurement needs clarity on flexibility: if we reduce retention mid-term, how are credits handled?
- Legal asked us to get a DocuSign-ready addendum that includes the cap and explicit data handling terms (encryption at rest, KMS compat).

If you can get a refreshed line-item CSV and a DocuSign draft by EOD Friday (Mar 12), we can route to legal and procurement for sign-off next week.

Thanks — copying Marissa (finance) and Karthik (platform) for budget/ops read.

—Sofia
From: Dan Sato <dan.sato@datadog.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Li <emma.li@datadog.com>, contracts@datadog.com
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scope + pricing for logs archival add-on

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for the clear asks — we've attached an itemized CSV with tiered cap options (Datadog-priced-tiers.csv) and a worked example using your usage sample. Key points: 

- Egress cap options: $2,000/month cap (up to 5TB rehydrate) or $4,500/month cap (up to 15TB), both include reduced per-GB charge above cap.
- Credit policy: committed SKUs include prorated credits if retention is reduced, applied to the remainder of the contract term (details in the draft addendum).
- Encryption/KMS: Datadog supports customer-managed KMS for enterprise Private plans; we'll include the clause in the addendum.

Attached: SOW-log-archival.xlsx (migration estimate) and Datadog-priced-tiers.csv (price examples). If the $4.5k cap sounds safer we can draft a DocuSign with that bucket and the credit language.

Would you prefer a short call to finalize cap level or shall we draft two DocuSign options (5TB vs 15TB)?

Regards,
Dan Sato
Senior Solutions Engineer, Datadog
Attachments: Datadog-priced-tiers.csv, SOW-log-archival.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scope + pricing for logs archival add-on

+1 on Dan's suggested $4.5k cap (15TB). That gives us breathing room for incident investigations. Also request legal to ensure egress above cap is clearly meterized and not a surprise percentage multiplier.

—Marissa
VP Finance, Redwood Inference
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@datadog.com>, contracts@datadog.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scope + pricing for logs archival add-on — ask to draft DocuSign with 15TB cap

Emma / Contracts —

Thanks for the quick work here. We want to proceed with the Committed option + the hybrid storage model, and include the $4,500/month cap (up to 15TB rehydrate) as a guaranteed monthly protection for the first 12 months. Please: 

- Draft a DocuSign addendum that includes: the 15TB cap line, explicit credit mechanics if we reduce retention mid-term, and a KMS/encryption clause (customer-managed keys supported).
- On the SOW: include a migration timeline (2 weeks for initial bulk transfer + rolling rehydration testing window) and a named SLT for support during cutover.
- Send the DocuSign link and the final priced CSV to procurement/legal.

I'll ask Legal to review once I have the DocuSign draft. Attaching the SOW reference noted earlier.

Thanks,
Sofia
Head of Platform Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: SOW-log-archival.xlsx
